worldcombat.skill.superpower.summary: Lowers its shoulder and drives low along the aim to the first real contact: one heavy physical blow that knocks the target back, after which the user's Attack and Defense both drop. Hitting a wall or charging into empty air only raises a puff of dust and costs nothing. The shock-wave form adds an aftershock at the real contact point at the cost of a lighter single hit, one more Defense stage and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.0: Open with the single heaviest hit up close
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.1: Knock a foe out of position
worldcombat.skill.superpower.use.2: Shock-wave form to blast a cluster gathered at the contact point
worldcombat.skill.superpower.description: Drives low and, on the first real body contact, deals about %1$s physical damage and knocks it about %2$s blocks along the contact line; heavier targets are pushed less.
Charge range %1$s blocks; on a hit the user's Attack drops %2$s stage(s) and Defense drops %3$s. Hitting a wall or empty air settles nothing and pays no stat cost.
Takes %1$s s to sink the weight in, then charges along the locked release direction at %2$s blocks/tick; it stops at the first body or wall and never curves around cover to chase the original target.
On a hit, the real contact point rings out an aftershock of radius %1$s blocks that blasts foes other than the main target that have line of sight to the contact point for %2$s of the base power and shoves them about 80% as far, without hitting the main target twice.
Focused form: all force goes into one target, casts faster and only drops the native one stage of Attack and Defense, but reaches no one else.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
On: the real contact point rings out an aftershock, blasting nearby foes with line of sight and leaving the blocks untouched; costs one more Defense stage, impact power x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +4 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (focused): all force into one target, faster cast, only the native single stage drop.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the charge from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy single hit finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Superpower back (0 = no limit). Higher makes it save the hit for a worthwhile trade.
worldcombat.skill.superpower.description: The impact only raises a puff of dust and fist-light at the real body or wall contact, tinted by the material it touches; no block is changed, and a whiff leaves just a puff of dust.
